idea-plugin.name: Kokedera - Moss Temple Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Kokedera - Moss Temple Theme

Bring the quiet of a moss-covered temple into your editor. Kokedera offers nine hand-tuned color themes inspired by forest greens, weathered stone, and warm lantern light — seven dark palettes and two light palettes.

Nine views of one place

Kokedera is a quiet temple among the roots of the World Tree, where moss covers the stone paths and a small golem tends the lanterns. Choose a different hour, season, or weather in the same place.

Palettes

  • Morning — Light: warm paper grounds, greens that read like ink
  • Dusk — Dark: deep forest greens, weathered stone and soft lantern light
  • Night — Dark: near-black grounds, brighter greens and warm lantern contrast
  • Spring — Dark: fresh greens and cherry blossom
  • Summer — Dark: dense, saturated greens and a teal stream
  • Autumn — Dark: rust, amber and ember over dark earth
  • Winter — Light: cool pale grounds, steel blue and a quiet red
  • Rain — Dark: wet teal, blue-green shadows and reflected lantern warmth
  • Mist — Dark: soft, desaturated greens and blue-grey distance
